realizes.rationale: _observed_symbol (memory/knowledge/read_anchors.py) places every defining extent of a symbol on the exact recorded blob; _observed_line_range places a recorded line range only when that blob holds the lines; AnchorResolution (models/knowledge/read_anchor.py) carries the resulting structured resolved_ranges and refuses them beside any other resolution.

AnchorResolution is declared in models/knowledge/read_anchor.py and ReviewFamilyMemberSource in models/knowledge/review_family_source.py; read.py and review_family_context.py import and re-export them so existing imports keep resolving.

9.note: `AnchorResolution` implements the retained boundary described above.
